title.narrative: Building Libya¿s national capacity to prevent and combat corruption and money laundering, (Phase II)

description.narrative:
The Action is a second phase of the previous project "EU Building Libya¿s National Capacity to Prevent & Combat Corruption and Money Laundering" (ENI/2020/416-639) jointly implemented by United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) and the United Nations Inter-regional Crime and Justice Research Institute (UNICRI) , funded by the European Union, to support Libyan authorities to build national capacity to prevent and combat corruption and money laundering. That first phase aimed to strengthen capacity to prevent acts of corruption, and promote cultures of transparency and ethical conduct, while enhancing operational capacity to prosecute acts of corruption, as well as the tracing, seizure, confiscation and recovery of assets linked to such corruption and other serious crime, with a view to ensure that any recovered assets are not corruptly used again and that these are directed to priority needs within Libya (for example, in the education, healthcare or infrastructure sectors).

Building on the previous achievements, the new phase will consolidate and expand them. Mainly creating awareness and advocating against anti-corruption, money laundering and supporting Libyan assets recovery. The Action will implement a number of activities including the provision of legal advice, and, where possible and practical, legislative drafting support on needed legislation; technical advice to relevant authorities to understand and put in place measures to prevent corruption and/or financial crimes; workshops and technical advice to strengthen capacity on financial crimes investigations; support the education system in introducing anti-corruption curricula and implement effective learning techniques for the various levels of education; support to institutions to establish expedited procedures to prosecute financial crimes; and technical advice on effective mapping and other modalities to trace, secure and manage assets linked to acts of corruption and/or financial crimes. These activities will assist the national Libyan authorities to initiate and manage investigation and prosecution in financial crimes, further enhance the tracing and managing of seized and confiscated assets and assist authorities to build a regulatory framework to combat corruption and enhance transparency.

Objective: National authorities are empowered to address corruption, money laundering, recover their proceeds, and build a culture of integrity within the Libyan administration system and across society.

Outcome 1: Measures to enhance transparency and integrity in the Libyan public administration system are adopted ¿ to be implemented by UNODC

Outcome 2: Authorities¿ operational and legal capacity to combat and prevent corruption and money laundering is strengthened - to be implemented by UNODC

Outcome 3: National, regional and international cooperation is strengthened to combat corruption and money laundering - to be implemented by UNODC

Outcome 4: Relevant Libyan institutions will continue to improve their capacity to adopt and implement good practices as the resolution of cases involving the recovery of assets linked to corruption, seized and confiscated assets ¿ to be implemented by UNICRI
